reason: I've had a fever, dry cough, and runny nose for four days.
diagnosis: Most likely COVID-19, given the acute dry cough, fever, fatigue, reduced smell, runny nose, and possible exposure through his symptomatic girlfriend.
keyPoints: Fever pattern and peak temperature, including onset and progression
Respiratory symptoms: dry vs productive cough, shortness of breath, wheeze, chest pain
COVID features: loss of smell/taste, fatigue, runny nose, sick contacts, recent travel/exposure
Red flags for pneumonia or severe disease: dyspnea, pleuritic pain, hypoxia, confusion
ENT/GI/systemic symptoms and alternative viral features: sore throat, myalgias, diarrhea, nausea
Past lung disease, immunocompromise, and other comorbidities/risk factors
Medications, allergies, smoking/vaping, and recent treatments tried
